title: Dining Tables
lead: Round pedestal tables and long tables in wood, stone looks and metal.
intro: Every table has a number, like Dining Table No. 08. Ask about it by number and we will come back with sizes, finishes, pricing and lead time.

models.name: Flared Pedestal Table
models.summary: A light wood top on a slim stem that flares out into a wide brass-tone base.
models.more: The stem flares into a wide brass-tone base, under a round or oval light wood top.

models.name: Fluted Pedestal Table
models.summary: Fluted wood pedestals under a round or oval top, in wood or a stone-look finish.
models.more: The fluted bases come as one round pedestal, two pedestals or one long base, with a wood or stone-look top.

models.name: Plinth-Base Wood Table
models.summary: A warm brown wood table on a solid base set on a slim plinth.
models.more: Choose a round drum pedestal, a long block base or an open frame, all on a slim plinth.

models.name: Stone Pedestal Table
models.summary: A stone-look top on a tapered cone pedestal, or on round columns with a narrow collar.
models.more: The base comes as a tapered cone or as round columns with a narrow collar, in dark or pale stone looks.

models.name: Wave-Base Wood Table
models.summary: A light wood top on a wide pedestal with a soft, wavy base.
models.more: The pedestal widens toward the floor and ends in a soft wavy edge.

models.name: Flared-Foot Pedestal Table
models.summary: A dark wood table on a pedestal that flares out onto a flat foot.
models.more: A dark wood pedestal flares out onto a flat foot, under a round or long top.

models.name: Curved-Leg Stone-Top Table
models.summary: A brown stone-look top on curved wood legs joined low by a stretcher.
models.more: Curved wood legs hold a brown stone-look top, with a low stretcher between them.

models.name: Cross-Slab Stone Table
models.summary: A round pale stone-look table on two slabs that cross under the top.
models.more: Two flat slabs cross under the round top, all in a pale stone look.

models.name: White Marble-Look Pedestal Table
models.summary: A white marble-look table with bold gray veining, on a solid rounded pedestal.
models.more: The top and pedestal share the same white, gray-veined marble look.

models.name: Domed-Column Stone Table
models.summary: A pale stone-look top on thick columns with rounded tops.
models.more: One thick column holds the round top, or two hold the oval, and there's a white marble-look version.

models.name: Block-Base Stone Table
models.summary: A long beige stone-look top on a single solid block.
models.more: A thick square-edged top sits on one solid block, in beige or dark brown stone looks.

models.name: Matte Cream Pedestal Table
models.summary: A matte cream table with soft, rounded edges on a solid pedestal.
models.more: Everything is in one matte cream finish, with soft rounded edges on the top and base.

models.name: Metal-Frame Stone Table
models.summary: A beige stone-look top on a slim dark metal frame.
models.more: A slim dark metal frame holds a beige stone-look top, round or long.

models.name: Stone-Top Wood Pedestal Table
models.summary: A pale stone-look top on wood pedestals.
models.more: A pale stone-look top sits on a wood drum, or on two wood slab legs for the long version.

models.name: Slim-Leg Wood Table
models.summary: A warm brown wood table on four slim legs, and a round version on a drum pedestal.
models.more: The long table stands on four slim legs, and the round one sits on a drum pedestal.

models.name: U-Base Wood Table
models.summary: A light wood table on an open U-shaped base.
models.more: The base is an open U shape, under a round or long light wood top.

models.name: Drum Pedestal Light Wood Table
models.summary: A light wood top on a solid drum or block pedestal.
models.more: A solid drum holds the round top, and a long block holds the long one.

models.name: Cluster-Column Wood Table
models.summary: A light wood top on clusters of round wood columns.
models.more: Round wood columns are grouped into one cluster for the round top, or two for the long one.

models.name: Frame-Base Wood Table
models.summary: A long warm brown wood table on a closed, rounded rectangular frame.
models.more: The base is a closed frame with rounded corners, in warm brown wood.

models.name: Column-Base Wood Table
models.summary: A warm brown wood top on round columns or an open U pedestal.
models.more: The long top sits on two columns, and the round top on a drum or an open U pedestal.

models.name: Brass-Tone Trestle Table
models.summary: A dark wood top on brass-tone T-shaped legs joined by a low stretcher.
models.more: The brass-tone legs meet the dark wood top in a T and are joined low by a stretcher.

models.name: Plinth Pedestal Wood Table
models.summary: A natural wood table on a solid pedestal with a rounded plinth.
models.more: The round top sits on a drum with a plinth, and the long top on a rounded open frame.

models.name: Arched-Leg Wood Table
models.summary: A natural wood table on legs with arched cut-outs.
models.more: Each leg has an arched cut-out, and the long version adds a stretcher between the ends.

models.name: Angled-Frame Wood Table
models.summary: A dark wood top on angled open-frame legs.
models.more: Angled frames splay out from the round table's center column, or stand in pairs under the long top.

models.name: Stone-Top Cross-Slab Table
models.summary: A pale stone-look top on crossed wood slabs.
models.more: Crossed wood slabs hold a pale stone-look top, with the base in light or warm brown wood.

models.name: Rounded-Leg Wood Table
models.summary: A textured light wood top on thick, rounded legs.
models.more: Thick rounded legs carry a textured light wood top, and a dark version is shown too.

models.name: Stepped Marble-Look Table
models.summary: A white marble-look top on a fluted pedestal that steps out at the foot.
models.more: The fluted pedestal steps out at the foot, all in a white, gray-veined marble look.

models.name: Bronze-Column Table
models.summary: A honey-toned stone-look top on a group of bronze-tone columns.
models.more: Grouped bronze-tone columns hold a honey-toned stone-look top, and there are dark and light wood versions.

models.name: Split-Column Wood Table
models.summary: A long dark wood table on two split column pedestals.
models.more: Two split columns hold the long dark wood top.

models.name: Slab-Leg Wood Table
models.summary: A weathered-look wood table on flat slab legs, with round versions on a frame or crossed base.
models.more: The long top stands on flat slab legs, and the round top on a square frame or crossed slabs.
